coverage.note: Shared translated algorithms, not identical source or a full-language/50-task claim.

method.cold_build: Fresh driver and compiler per sample; cache disabled. OS and installed-library caches retained. Source staging outside timer. Complete wall and native build phases retained.
method.runtime: Same Node/V8 and flags for both. test/run use official inputs/iterations/warmups. bounded retains production problem sizes with reduced counts recorded per case. Same state retained after warmup. Preparation, startup, engine compilation and output outside clock; no per-element host calls. Two Blot clock packet crossings versus two Goose scalar imports are part of their ABI costs. Common process wall includes parsing the Blot TypeScript guest host for both backends; it is not Goose's standalone runner startup score.
method.representation: Goose byte buffers use U8; Blot stores identical values in U32, 4x element payload bytes; owner and arena overhead are separate. Fixed backing capacities retained. Sort U32 values are nonnegative and preserve I32 ordering; ports restrict sizes to100000/400000, where exact integer RNG conversion matches every Goose F64 RNG state. Mandelbrot uses explicit ordered F32 in BOTH sources; original F64 remains unavailable. Fannkuch indices/permutations are nonnegative; U32 checksum wrap preserves final U32 accumulation. Wider parameter/clock plumbing stays outside kernels. Custom Hash::SHA256 is not cryptographic SHA-256.
method.ordering: Build phase sequential, then runtime phase; seeded paired shuffling, no deliberate concurrent measurement work.

catalog.notes: Upstream task name; this is LangArena's custom hash, not standard cryptographic SHA-256.

change.intent: Transfer fresh fixed-array owners through reusable private calls instead of discarding helpers and expanding into each caller. Preserve ABI8/session2 and public ownership semantics.
change.contract: Only live nondedicated nonpersistent fixed-region owners with plain inline elements, unconditional singleton result donors outside variant payloads, no mixed fresh alternatives. Owner roles extend input prefix; duplicate aliases and borrowed siblings share one caller root. Writer events remain input-only.
change.cleanup: Import real returned descriptors at caller depth before closing packets. Lexical rewind preserves transferred extents; packet slots close immediately, packet bytes can remain beneath returned extents until enclosing rewind.
change.fallback: Conditional donors, mixed fresh/input alternatives, resizable/dedicated owners, hidden captures and escaping stored borrows retain fallback/rejection.
change.constant_evaluation_repair: Selected methods now evaluate typed callable aliases/overapplication through existing application semantics. Exact named arity retains seeded fast path, effects/providers remain checked. Restores preexisting failed staged sqrt/ceil/from/add behavior after primitive-alias checkpoint.

paired_blot_runtime.method: Five fresh-process paired runs per case, seeded side order; same bounded inputs/iterations/internal warmups and checked checksum. Existing before and final after cold artifacts; no concurrent deliberate measurement work.
paired_blot_runtime.interpretation: All five before/after Blot kernel artifacts are byte-identical. Timing differences are controls/noise, not new runtime code-generation gains.

gdev.note: Three fresh uncached pairs with randomized side order and unchanged Gdev/Ink/std inputs. Session startup included. Shared-host round; do not compare its6.85s baseline against earlier5.81s snapshot.

profile.note: Separate profiling diagnostic; exclusive phases are not additive with overlapping backend timing. requested_bytes are cumulative allocation requests, not peak memory.

closure.source:
const make_scalar = func (captured: U32) => return do:
  let saved = captured
  return func (argument: U32): U32 => return @u32.add saved argument
const invoke_left = func (callback: U32 -> U32) -> (argument: U32): U32 => return callback argument
const invoke_right = func (callback: U32 -> U32) -> (argument: U32): U32 => return callback argument
const invoke_twice = func (callback: U32 -> U32) -> (argument: U32): U32 => return @u32.add (invoke_left callback argument) (invoke_right callback argument)
entry const shared_parents = func (input: U32): U32 => return do:
  let marker: GrowArray U32 = #[input]
  let first = invoke_twice (make_scalar marker[0]) 3
  let second = invoke_twice (make_scalar (@u32.add marker[0] 11)) 7
  return @u32.add first second

variant.source:
type Choice is data = $Whole U32 | $Fraction F32 | $Absent
const inspect = func (choice: Choice): U32 => return case choice of
  $Whole number => number
  $Fraction number => @u32.add 100 (@f32.to_u32 number)
  $Absent => 31
entry const variants = func (input: U32) => return do:
  let marker: GrowArray U32 = #[input]
  let missing = inspect $Absent
  let whole = inspect ($Whole marker[0])
  let fraction = inspect ($Fraction 3.5)
  let again = inspect ($Whole (@u32.add marker[0] 7))
  let joined = if @u32.eq input 0 then $Absent else $Whole marker[0]
  return #[missing, whole, fraction, again, inspect joined]
